title: Seated Curl Machine
summary: A selectorized biceps curl with a fixed path and steady resistance.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: commercial gym machine (this exercise's own machine).

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for biceps (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly biceps total.
Library rating 0.3 for forearms (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly forearms total.

setup.text: Sit with your elbows on the pad, lined up with the machine's pivot.
Lower under control to almost straight.

form_cues.cue: Keep upper arms on the pad
Keep your elbows planted. If they lift, the weight is too heavy.

mistakes.text: Shortening the range at the bottom.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Brachialis & brachioradialis bias.
Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Biceps long-head stretch, Less isolation.
Swap sheet: Peak-contraction focus, One side at a time.

notes: Ratings, swap attributes and cues are the library model (modeled). An authored page will replace this one.
